title: T42 (Tinyana) PNC - Ki Ani Hashem Rofecha — Acronym Amen Ken Yehi Ratzon
author: Pettek Nanach

beginner.en: The verse 'For I, Hashem, am your healer' (Exodus 15:26) hints at the answer 'Amen, may it be His will' through its initial letters: Amen-Ken-Yehi-Ratzon. Healing flows precisely through this affirming response after blessing or prayer. To say 'Amen ken yehi ratzon' is to draw down the divine healing embedded in the verse itself.

intermediate.en: **"כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה רֹפְאֶךָ"** (שמות טו:כו) — ראשי תיבות: **אָמֵן כֵּן יְהִי רָצוֹן**. Refuah is drawn through the affirmation 'Amen ken yehi ratzon' — its rashei-teivos are encoded in the very name of the Healer. (See elsewhere — likely Likutey Halakhos and Likutey Moharan I, Torah 60 on amen.)

scholarly.he: [T2:42] רת"ש "כי אני ה' רפאך" — אכי"ר. עי' לק"ה ברכת הלל; לק"מ ח"א ס' ס' בעניין אמן.
